body:
> [!CAUTION]
> **Risk: high.** Moves where a dev run keeps `auth.enc` (session token, `safeStorage`) and changes app startup order in `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts` (sensitive words: auth, session).


| id | severity | outcome |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | nit | fixed in f3e96bcf — test hard-codes `<appData>/kaipu-record` and pins package.json name/productName |
| S2 | nit | declined, follow-up — dev and prod can now run together on the shared vault: startup/quit `cleanupDragCopies` wipes `.kaipu/drag`; `recoverStrandedRecordings` could move the other app's `.part` after a 2+ min pause |
| S3 | nit | declined, known limit — a custom vault picked in prod lives in prod's `preferences.json`; dev uses the default folder |
| S4 | nit | fixed in f3e96bcf — comment no longer claims an unverified keychain entry name |

Rounds: 2 of 5. Round 1: Opus subagent (fresh context), 4 nits. Round 2: Codex CLI (different provider, read-only, account default model), APPROVE, no findings.

Verdict for f3e96bcf7f9da4f8ac9485ffef6161284901996d (patch-id 0ea8b5cb683603d6d8cb46d048928e2672a42d45): approved, only nits remain.
